about_the_game:
Once, children sang in the fields.
Now the wind only whispers names of the dead.
Velmora — a village on the edge of light and shadow.
And today… you've come back.

Not as a hero. Not even as a man seeking redemption.
But as the only one who can still hear what stirs beyond the edge of town.

The chapel stands locked.
The crypt remains sealed.
But far from the altar, in a forgotten place, something waits — something older than the dust on the gravestones.

An echo of the past…
A strange hum of light and glass…
And a fight that will prove whether you can stand against the first touch of death.

⚔️ In This Demo

  • Face your first undead – a taste of the battles to come.

  • Explore Velmora’s outskirts – meet its haunted souls and feel the weight of the wind.

  • Find the hidden path – somewhere, a strange machine hums in the dark… and it does not belong here.

  • Experience the atmosphere – cinematic dialogue, fully voiced characters, and a world that refuses to explain itself.

🌑 Final Word
The Curse of Velmora: Prologue Demo is just the beginning.

A first step into the shadows — and a taste of the journey ahead.

In Velmora… even the smallest detour can lead to something unforgettable.

🙋‍♂️ A Note from the Developer
This demo was carved from the same stone as the full game — same shadows, same voices, same stubborn heart.
But I wanted to give you a taste, and maybe a secret you didn’t expect.
If you find it… you’ll know.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 6th gen / AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU: GTX 1050 Ti / RX 560
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 10th gen / Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 / RTX 3050 (Ray Tracing ON)
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
